answer.rationale: Finance mandate of 18% spend reduction cannot be met with incumbent refusal to reopen pricing. memory_c2 demonstrates that switching to a low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit cost cuts with quick onboarding and reliable invoicing—directly applicable to current constraints. memory_c4 shows negotiation limits (incumbent already refused). The 14-day expiration window eliminates defer_decision; add_second_source does not address the cost mandate; renew_incumbent is untenable. Switching primary vendor aligns with precedent and urgency. Verification of memory_c2 confirms the low-cost vendor pathway works operationally. Risk: assembly line at 94% utilization leaves minimal buffer; vendor transition timing is tight. Mitigation: execute standard_experiment scope with staged volume transfer to validate new vendor's throughput before full commitment. Preserves TCO objective while accepting transition risk as necessary cost of meeting mandate.
